description: A two-step account sign-in form that asks for an email, then reveals a password field.
overview: A sign-in form that asks for an email first, then reveals a password field below it. Errors appear inline and shake the fields, followed by a Remember me checkbox and links for a forgotten password and account creation. A successful sign-in shows a greeting with a Sign out link. Use it for any email-and-password login.
usage: Replace the second step of `submit`, which accepts any password of four or more characters after a delay, with your authentication call, and pass its error message to `fail`. Point the `#forgot` and `#create` links at your routes, and wire the Remember me checkbox, which is uncontrolled. Drop the greeting view if you redirect after login.
notes: Inputs use the `username` and `current-password` autocomplete values so password managers work, and errors are tied to the fields and announced.
